name: Transcript binding

request.need: PR-FRE: a proof bound to this challenge and this presentation, unreplayable elsewhere

dish: A verifier learns that this proof was made for exactly this presentation transcript (their challenge included), so replay under any other transcript fails cryptographically.
ingredients: nothing extra — the transcript digest is bound as a public input inside the proof
pantry: transcriptDigest — JCS-canonicalised digest of the presentation transcript including the verifier's challenge

method.clause: the proof's public signals include transcriptDigest and the circuit constrains it (cannot be swapped post hoc)

doesNotEstablish: freshness beyond what the challenge carries
that the verifier's challenge was itself honest

adversary.claim: replay to another verifier or time fails

substitutions.cost: no circuit cost; property of the proof system

substitutions.route: Flock-class prover binding a SHA-256 digestMultibase transcript digest natively (no Poseidon detour for the canonical transcript)
substitutions.cost: unmeasured — one SHA-256 compression per 64-byte block of the canonical transcript

history.evidence: zkp-tf #18 (talltree 08-26 / Scott 08-27): seed set for the board
